title: *FRESH New Reno*Near HOTspots & Downtown/Fire-pit+
description:
NEWLY updated inside & out!  Get ready to hit the local shops & foodie hot spots in trendy East End. Make this your home base for all Nashville has to offer. Central local just 3.5 miles to downtown/stadium. Walk a few blocks to FAB restaurants/bars or a quick ride & you are at ALL the best spots. Great Backyard! W/fire pit, hammock, grill , BOCCE & More games. Stylish decor, comfy beds, crisp linens + great art = a cozy place to call home. Separate upstairs can be rented too for big groups too!

The space
This is a newly remodeled bungalow is set up exclusively for vacation rental.   Attention to comfort and detail is important to us.  Mattress' are Plush natural latex and bamboo covered & include hypo allergenic sleeping pillows with linen bedding. In addition we have encased all the mattress' and pillows with covers to ensure a hygienic stay. Cozy robes for your use are in every closet. With ample space to enjoy your friends and family or to enjoy tranquil retreat. Super high speed wireless internet, 2 Smart TV's , games, multiple desks, the home is set up for work or play. Fire pit, picnic table, grill and newly landscaped backyard is a nice break from outings.  The kitchen is big and the dining room boast a large table.  Super convenient to grocery , gyms, yoga and more. The YMCA is just a stones throw and has a great gym - the offer free use up to 14 days a year with your ID. There is a washer and dryer for your use too.  The space also has an alarm system if you wish.

Guest access
EASY ACCESS! Keyless entry allows for easy and flexible check in. Parking is provided on site 2 spaces one behind the other along the fence & more on the street if needed!  The house is just off the main corridor so it's easy to find and easy to come and go! Uber/Lyft/Taxi's are very easy to get.

Other things to note
The house is super close to lots of enjoyable areas. 1.5 miles gets you to 5 points. 3.6 miles and your in Downtown!  We are 2 doors from Gallatin Road which is the main corridor in East. So super easy to find and get to hot spots. The bus stop is less then a block and you can get you to 5 points area or to downtown quickly. Uber, Lyft and Taxi's are very good when jumping around especially in downtown  where parking is a bit pricey. There is an upstairs unit that is also a vacation rental. We have rules on shoes and noise to ensure everyone's stay is pleasant. If you have a big group you can rent the both for a total of 11 people or just make some new friends. The backyard and side porch are common areas of use. There is a wireless speaker for your use and if you would like we can provide additional cleaning service or recommendation for childcare if needed for longer stays. You can walk to the YMCA for gym and indoor pool use  & it's free up to 14 visits a year just bring your ID.

host_details:
My husband James and I are part of the film community here in Nashville. He is a local & I have called Nashville home since '97.   We, and our 2 kids, are avid Airbnb users both professionally & personally. We like to explore, drink lots of coffee,  eat good food, and hang with family & friends. We love being out in nature and anywhere near water.  We now have 3 full time guest homes; one in East Nashville ,  our beloved cabin JustoutofNashville at Center Hill Lake (just 90 minutes from Nashville) and our favorite home away in Whitefish, Montana. We have put together effortless, comfy, and stylish spaces that we ourselves love to stay in.  All our homes are very family & work friendly. So if you are here to work, play or just relax and recharge we have you covered.  We look forward to sharing our home with you and helping you have a fantastic stay.
